name: oxidised-jewellery
description: Oxidised jewellery e-commerce storefront, admin panel and Node.js API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.install:ci: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix web install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
